# telnyx_sim_card_device_details (Data Source)

The device a SIM card is in, as last reported by the network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sim_card_id` (String) The sim card.

### Read-Only

- `brand_name` (String) Brand of the device where the SIM card is being used in.
- `device_type` (String) Type of the device where the SIM card is being used in.
- `imei` (String) IMEI of the device where the SIM card is being used in.
- `model_name` (String) Brand of the device where the SIM card is being used in.
- `operating_system` (String) Operating system of the device where the SIM card is being used in.
- `record_type` (String)
